AWM Media Fashion Show & Award Ceremony

Fri, Nov 16, 2018 · 4:30 PM – 8:00 PM · Leopold’s Mississippi Gardens

When
Fri, Nov 16, 2018 · 4:30 PM – 8:00 PM
Where
Leopold’s Mississippi Gardens
9500 W River Rd, Minneapolis, MN
Cost

Share

IAmMoody invites you to the AWM-MN Fashion Show & Award Ceremony! Minnesota TV and radio personalities will strut their stuff on the runway featuring resort wear, outfits that transition from the office to a holiday party, plus holiday wear produced by the IAmMoody team. AWM-MN will also be presenting the Anne Gallagher Lifetime Achievement Award to Diana Pierce and Paul Douglas.

Buy Tickets Now!

$75 includes your ticket for the fashion show and dinner.
